1.e4 c5 2.d3 Nc6 3.c3 d6 4.f4.strategy: Takes space on the kingside and the e5 square under control, building a broad pawn front. It leaves holes behind it, notably on e3 and g3, and commits White to a plan on the kingside that is hard to undo.
1.e4 c5 2.d3 Nc6 3.c3 d6 4.f4.name: Sicilian Defence: Big Clamp Formation
